summary: Audit A-034: the gate's '0 to 9 ms idle over 22 launches' had no artifact. scripts/launcher_stderr_exposure.py runs the real launch.sh against a fake server and times how long after the launcher returns the filter's summary row is on disk (stdout/stderr to /dev/null so a held pipe cannot hide the gap). 100 launches per mode, 4 cores, gawk 5.2.1: idle 0 to 18.65 ms median 0; 8 busy processes beside it 0 to 55.27 ms median 9.2; 0 missing in 200.
